req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on second and subsequent DELETE calls for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-030 requires DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} to be idempotent: the first call returns HTTP 204 (success), and every subsequent call for the same squad number returns HTTP 404 (not found). The test suite covers: (1) positive/STC — the full state transition from EXISTS→DELETED→ABSENT, asserting exact status codes 204 then 404; (2) negative/NEG — calling DELETE on a squad number that never existed returns 404 immediately; (3) boundary/BVA — a third consecutive DELETE call still returns 404, confirming idempotency holds beyond the second call; (4) DT — verifying the first DELETE returns exactly 204 (not 200, not 404) to catch constant/comparison mutations; (5) EP — a freshly created player (squad 27+) is deleted twice, confirming the pattern works for API-created resources. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient, exact status-code assertions, and are self-contained.

tests.name: test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=5 exists in the pre-loaded database
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: First DELETE returns HTTP 204 No Content
Second DELETE returns HTTP 404 Not Found
State transition: EXISTS -> DELETED -> ABSENT confirmed
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_idempotent_first_204_second_404():
    r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
    assert r2.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_idempotent_api_created_player
preconditions: Squad number 27 does not exist in the pre-loaded database
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=27 to create a new player
Verify player is gone via GET /players/squadnumber/27 — expect 404
trace: EP: equivalence partition — API-created player (not pre-seeded)
Catches mutations on status codes 201, 204, 404 and condition inversions
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_idempotent_api_created_player():
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test',
        'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 27,
        'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    rc = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert rc.status_code == 201
    r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/27')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/27')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    rg = client.get('/players/squadnumber/27')
    assert rg.status_code == 404

FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
actions: Assert second response is exactly 404 and not 204 and not 200
expected: Second DELETE does not return 204 or 200
trace: R-PLAYER-030: second DELETE must be 404, not 204
NEG: negative path — second call must not succeed
Catches mutations: 404->204, 404->200, boolean negation on not-found check
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_second_call_is_exactly_404_not_204():
    r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/8')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/8')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.status_code != 204
    assert r2.status_code != 200
    assert r2.status_code != 500
